name: Sad_2
short_caption: The robot turns its head down and to the side while bringing its hands slightly forward in a sad, dejected gesture.
movement_description: The robot starts from its neutral standing posture and slowly lowers its head while turning it slightly to the left, looking down. Simultaneously, it brings both hands inward and slightly forward toward its lower torso, fingers curled. It holds this dejected position briefly before slowly returning its head to the center and lowering its arms back to the neutral resting pose.
